name: 20972-logprobdecode-llama31-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- a byte-identical mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies. ~15 GB of weights.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, dense bf16 decoder, 32 layers, GQA 32 query over 8 KV heads, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, 16.06 GB of weights on one card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 16 streams, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 240 requests with a 3600 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn over `/v1/chat/completions`. Prompt 1024 tokens and generation 1024 tokens, both fixed (guidellm expresses a fixed length by declaring no `_stdev` key; a literal `0` is rejected by its validator). Every request carries `logprobs: true`, `top_logprobs: 5`, `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`. Responses are streamed with `stream_interval` at its default of 1, so the server emits one chunk per decode step. Seed 20972.
purpose: A token-scoring assistant streaming 1024-token answers with top-5 alternatives per token, 16 concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# A defaulted launch at the commit named in setupcard.md `commit_id`.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
